name: morphedra-mcp
description: Claude Desktop extension for the Morphedra Whiteboard Video API

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack: npm run build && mcpb pack . morphedra.mcpb
